en.headline: Ex-lawmaker William Wong bailed on four traffic charges
en.dek: The former legislator made a first appearance at Sha Tin Court over an alleged drink-driving crash at CUHK and must return on 11 November.
body: Former Legislative Council member William Wong Kam-fai appeared at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday on four traffic charges and was released on HK$5,000 cash bail until 11 November.

Wong, 66, faces counts of driving with alcohol above the prescribed limit, dangerous driving, failing to stop after an accident and failing to report an accident involving damage. The prosecution said the case relates to 29 June at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, where a car allegedly hit two parked vehicles. His breath-alcohol reading was given as 45 micrograms per 100 millilitres, against a legal limit of 22 micrograms.

He was not required to enter a plea. Defence lawyer Paul Tse sought time for legal advice. Bail conditions include a driving ban, fortnightly police reporting and no contact with prosecution witnesses. Wong resigned from the Legislative Council in early July after the arrest became public.

zh.headline: 前議員黃錦輝酒駕四罪提堂 准保釋至11月
zh.dek: 黃錦輝周三在沙田裁判法院首次應訊，暫毋須答辯，以5,000元現金保釋，下一次聆訊定於11月11日。
body: 前立法會議員黃錦輝周三在沙田裁判法院就四項交通控罪首次應訊，獲准以5,000元現金保釋，須於11月11日再訊。
現年66歲的黃錦輝被控酒後駕駛、危險駕駛、意外後沒有停車，以及涉及財物損毀的意外後沒有報案。控方指案件與6月29日在香港中文大學校園有關，一輛私家車涉嫌撞向兩輛停泊車輛。其呼氣酒精濃度報45微克／100毫升，法定上限為22微克。
他暫毋須答辯。辯方律師謝偉俊要求時間徵詢法律意見。保釋條件包括禁止駕駛、每兩星期向警方報到，以及不得接觸控方證人。黃錦輝在事件公開後已於7月初辭任立法會議員。
